Definition: from G2316 and a presumed derivative of G4154; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, theópneustos is the word for given by inspiration of God, God-breathed. In 2 Timothy 3:16, All scripture is given by inspiration of God.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Scripture is not man’s guess about God; it is breathed out by God Himself, and I receive it as His word.
